facts.fact: The Ministry of Technology and Science published the National ICT Policy 2023, with a foreword by the Minister, as the government's revision of the 2006 National ICT Policy; the document gives no adoption date, so the published date of 11 October 2023 is used.
The full policy text is hosted on the Ministry of Technology and Science's own website as a PDF; the document gives no other date, so its published date is used.
The policy states no end year or period of validity; it is anchored on Vision 2030 but sets no term of its own (published date used).

Chapter 5 makes the Ministry responsible for ICTs responsible for policy coordination, implementation, monitoring and evaluation, with the Cabinet Office also monitoring and evaluating implementation and ZICTA regulating the sector (published date used).

The financing section lists the government national budget among seven possible sources, with bilateral and multilateral financing, FDI, private finance, capital markets and PPPs, and states no budget line or amount for the policy (published date used).

note: Plan: the document states an M&E framework 'shall be developed' and sets no dated actions or costs; no reporting is stated.
